comparison: 6.H.01 exemplar: 14,074 teaching words, 13 SVGs, 52 questions; target 13,486 words, 13 SVGs, 52 questions with existing reader shell.

review.scientific: Internal review: checked taxonomic and nutritional distinctions, host-range definitions, cuticle and wall properties, callose/lignin chemistry, PR enzyme specificity, phytoanticipin origin, pmr4 SA genetic evidence (Nishimura 2003), saponin detoxification, nematode feeding sites, DCL/AGO silencing and all question keys/calculations. Numerical checks: conditional infection 1%; penetration 15% versus 35%; 100-fold 2 logs; independent remaining growth 56%; incidence 30%; factorial interaction 75 percentage points; exam calculations 1 log, equal 2 logs, 10 percentage points, 56%, 30%, 2%, 5 versus 50 yield loss, 15%. Hypothetical data labeled. No external peer review.
review.editorial: Distinct internal pass: corrected ambiguous question, added verified references, improved distractors, balanced answer letters, extended misconception rationales, added explanatory tables and figures, source links, diagram zoom and connected sections. Reader shell retained.

score_basis: Scientific 20: checked core scientific mechanisms, primary evidence and arithmetic. Coverage 15: mapped all roadmap topics. Depth 15: measured eligible prose. Pedagogy 9: connected sequence, some compact transitions. Illustrations 9: accessible static original figures, no browser visual test. Exam 9: all answer keys and explanations checked, some simple recall distractors. Analysis 5: calculations and causal experiments. Revision 5: summary, checklist, recall and table. Reader 4: existing shell and controls statically preserved, runtime untested. Technical 4: canonical, links and static integrity verified; deployment/live and browser tests unperformed. Internal scoring, not external peer review.
